newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht eases late, interbank rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht eases late, interbank rate steady.

text.p: The Thai baht weakened against the dollar in late trade on Tuesday on short-covering of the U.S. unit and an expected rebound of the dollar abroad, dealers said.
The baht eased to 25.950/25.953 to the dollar late from 25.934/25.939 in early trade, dealers said.
"Some interbank players were heavily buying the dollar in the afternoon. They expect a possible rebound of the U.S. unit against major currencies," said one dealer at a European bank.
The dollar demand was also triggered by some short covering after heavy selling of the dollar recently, she added.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.93 per dollar, against 25.95 on Monday.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was unchanged at 10.50/11.50 satangs per dollar late.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 8.00 percent, unchanged from early morning trade on ample money supply in the system, dealers said.
